name: Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct
notes: ByteDance's open dense model, and a useful data point: it is DENSE, with no MoE and no MLA, at 36B. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 64 layers x 8 kv_heads x head_dim 128 x 2 x 2 bytes = 64 x 8 x 128 x 2 x 2 = 262,144 B/token (256 KiB), the same as DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B and 3.7x DeepSeek-V3. head_dim 128 is explicit. gqa_ratio 10 (80 heads / 8 kv heads) - a wider GQA than typical. hidden 5120, intermediate 27648, vocab 201088, tie_word_embeddings false. Our config arithmetic gives 36.6B against a 36B name, consistent. Context: max_position_embeddings 524288 with rope_theta 10000000 and rope_scaling rope_type 'default' with no other parameters - i.e. natively long, not extended. That is a 512k native window on a dense model, which is unusual and is the main serving claim. Confidence 0.85: config, safetensors total and the Apache-2.0 licence are all confirmed from the card frontmatter (license: apache-2.0) and README badge. The card states no explicit active-parameter figure, but this is a dense model so active = total by construction.
